limits: Board-sense high input, pin C2 low plus external vector 66 are PC fixtures; physical wiring/thresholds are not measured.

INTC2 source 30 delivery uses the generic forced-interrupt model, synthetic idle scheduler yield is disabled, and CC/TC acknowledgements use a narrow W1C adapter. eMMC payload copy and completion are immediate.
The completed-write path reaches cache-loop completion before a fresh native cold boot; final power-latch hardware is not tested.

The cut controls reconstruct zero/one/all completed commands before old-bank invalidation and invoke the actual stock cold reader in a stopped entry fixture. No torn sector or physical brownout is simulated.
Only pending bank 0 with old bank 1 is covered. It exposes a counterexample, not an exhaustive storage-fault proof.
